instruction: Speak in Spanish. As you read this, I want your emotion to change. Begin neutrally, then transition to surprise, and finally to joy.
text: Recibí una nota de la oficina central, dice que revise el anexo B. A ver... un momento... ¡No me lo puedo creer! ¡Me han concedido la beca para estudiar en el extranjero el próximo año!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio clearly follows the dynamic emotion progression, starting neutral, transitioning to audible surprise, and ending with clear joy.

instruction_evidence.neutral: The first sentence is delivered in a matter-of-fact, neutral tone.
instruction_evidence.surprise: The middle section ('A ver... un momento... ¡No me lo puedo creer!') features a shift in pacing and pitch that effectively conveys realization and surprise.
instruction_evidence.joy: The final sentence is spoken with an upbeat, excited, and happy tone.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds human-like, and the emotional transitions feel organic and smooth.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery captures the nuances of the emotional shift very well, using pacing, pitch, and tone effectively.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Begin this line slowly, as if you are begging. Then, your tone should become strong and defiant, and your speaking rate should get faster.
text: Te lo ruego, considera lo que te estoy diciendo, es importante para ambos. Pero si no quieres verlo, está bien. ¡Yo seguiré mi propio camino y demostraré que tengo razón!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio perfectly executes the requested dynamic progression. The first half is slow and effectively sounds pleading, while the second half distinctly shifts to a faster rate and a strong, defiant tone.

instruction_evidence.tone_progression: The speaker clearly starts with a vulnerable, begging tone and smoothly transitions into a firm and defiant attitude for the second half of the text.
instruction_evidence.speed_progression: The speaking rate is noticeably slower during the pleading section and speeds up significantly as the speaker becomes defiant.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice is smooth and human-like with no obvious synthetic artifacts.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The emotional contrast is sharply drawn and convincingly delivered, strongly enhancing the intended dynamic shift.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Deliver this with a building sense of urgency, starting slow and methodical, and getting faster and faster until the end.
text: Primero, tienes que entender el concepto básico, que es fundamental. Luego, aplicas la fórmula a los datos que te hemos dado. A partir de ahí, los cálculos se vuelven más sencillos y puedes resolver el resto del problema con mucha más agilidad.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio perfectly executes the dynamic instruction, starting at a slow and methodical pace, and progressively increasing speed to deliver a strong sense of building urgency by the end.

instruction_evidence.speed_progression: The first sentence is spoken slowly and deliberately. The second sentence speeds up slightly to a normal pace. The final sentences are delivered very rapidly.
instruction_evidence.building_urgency: The gradual increase in pacing effectively conveys the requested sense of urgency without feeling abrupt or flattened.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice is smooth and the transition in speed feels very human-like and natural, with no synthetic artifacts.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is highly expressive, using the pacing effectively to shape the intended tone and urgency.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. I want you to begin with an unnaturally high-pitched voice, then transition smoothly down to your normal vocal range by the end of the sentence.
text: ¡Ay, qué susto! Pensé que algo malo había pasado. Pero no, ya veo que estás bien. Menos mal. Vamos a sentarnos un momento, y me cuentas qué ha sucedido con tranquilidad.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio perfectly executes the requested dynamic pitch progression, starting with an unnaturally high pitch and smoothly transitioning down to a normal vocal range by the end of the speech.

instruction_evidence.pitch_start: The speaker begins with an appropriately unnaturally high-pitched voice on '¡Ay, qué susto!'.
instruction_evidence.pitch_transition: The pitch gradually and smoothly lowers across the sentences, reaching a normal conversational pitch by the final sentence.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Despite the requested unnatural starting pitch, the overall transition is smooth and the voice sounds relatively human-like throughout the shift.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The emotional delivery matches the text well, conveying initial panic shifting into calm relief, which strongly supports the pitch transition.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Deliver this line with a progression of emotions and volume: begin happy and normal, then become worried and quiet, and conclude fearful and very quiet.
text: ¡Qué bien, por fin llegamos a la cabaña! Es un poco más vieja de lo que recordaba, y la puerta está entreabierta. Un momento... creo que hay alguien adentro.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio perfectly executes the requested dynamic progression. It starts happy and at a normal volume, clearly shifts to a quieter, worried tone in the middle, and finishes with a very quiet, fearful whisper.

instruction_evidence.emotion_progression: The speaker clearly transitions from a happy tone to a worried one, ending with a convincing fearful delivery.
instruction_evidence.volume_progression: The volume noticeably decreases across the three stages, moving from a normal speaking volume down to a hushed tone, and finally to a very quiet whisper.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech sounds highly natural, with excellent pacing and no synthetic artifacts.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is highly expressive, with well-acted emotional shifts and effective use of whispering to convey fear.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Begin speaking with a hesitant, uncertain tone, but as you continue, your voice should become firm and decisive.
text: He estado pensando mucho en las opciones... y... bueno, no ha sido fácil. Pero después de considerarlo todo, he llegado a una conclusión. Me quedo aquí para terminar el proyecto.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio perfectly executes the dynamic instruction, smoothly transitioning from a clearly hesitant start to a firm and confident conclusion.

instruction_evidence.hesitant_start: The audio begins with a very natural hesitation sound ('Mmm') and is spoken with a slow, uncertain, and slightly shaky voice.
instruction_evidence.firm_conclusion: By the phrase 'Pero después...', the pacing picks up and the final sentence is delivered with strong, decisive, and authoritative confidence.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech sounds highly human-like, with the hesitations and pauses feeling very organic and free of synthetic artifacts.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The emotional shift is rich and well-acted, bringing excellent expressive depth to the delivery.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Begin this line in a very slow, very quiet manner. As you speak, build to a normal volume and speed, as if a thought is solidifying in your mind.
text: Parece que... la vida es una serie de puertas... y al final, no se trata de cuántas abrimos, sino de si tuvimos el coraje de cruzar el umbral de las más importantes.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The speaker successfully executes the dynamic progression, starting very slowly and quietly, and gradually building to a normal speed and volume, matching the 'solidifying thought' instruction perfectly.

instruction_evidence.speed: The audio begins with extremely slow pacing and pauses, gradually accelerating to a conversational, normal speed by the middle of the sentence.
instruction_evidence.volume: The delivery starts very quietly, almost whispered, and steadily increases to a normal speaking volume as the thought progresses.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The transition is smooth and organic, making the speech sound highly humanlike without synthetic stiffness.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The expressive variation is excellent, perfectly capturing the nuanced scenario of a thought slowly forming and solidifying.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Your tone should shift back and forth between sarcastic and complaining. Start sarcastic, then get whiny, and then return to sarcasm.
text: Me encanta trabajar en equipo, es lo mejor. Especialmente cuando soy el único que hace todo el trabajo. Es genial ver cómo los demás se relajan mientras yo paso la noche en vela. Pero claro, el mérito será para todos por igual, ¡qué justo! Ya estoy harto, ¿por qué siempre tengo que cargar con todo? Es increíble que a nadie más le importe.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio successfully follows the dynamic progression, starting with a strong, fake-upbeat sarcastic tone, shifting to a more grounded, exasperated and complaining tone in the middle, and returning to a slightly mocking, sarcastic lilt at the end.

instruction_evidence.sarcastic_start: The speaker starts with exaggerated, fake enthusiasm ('Me encanta trabajar en equipo...'), clearly conveying sarcasm.
instruction_evidence.whiny_complaining_middle: The tone drops the fake positivity at 'Ya estoy harto...' and becomes audibly exasperated and complaining.
instruction_evidence.sarcastic_return: On the final sentence ('Es increíble...'), the pitch rises again into a biting, incredulous, and sarcastic delivery.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech is smooth and humanlike, with natural pacing and breathing pauses.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The vocal delivery is highly expressive, effectively contrasting the fake upbeat sarcasm with genuine-sounding frustration.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Your delivery needs three distinct phases. Phase one: quiet, slow, thoughtful. Phase two: a furious climax, very loud and very fast. Phase three: quiet, slow, sad resignation.
text: Uno intenta construir algo, pieza por pieza, con cuidado. ¡Y luego llegas tú y lo destruyes todo en un segundo sin pensarlo! Y yo... me quedo aquí, entre las ruinas.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio successfully executes the three distinct phases, demonstrating clear shifts in volume, speed, and emotion across the text.

instruction_evidence.phase_one: The beginning is delivered quietly, slowly, and thoughtfully.
instruction_evidence.phase_two: The middle section features a noticeable increase in volume, pace, and agitation, matching the furious climax.
instruction_evidence.phase_three: The final sentence returns to a quiet, slow pace with a sad, resigned tone.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds human-like and the transitions between emotions feel relatively natural.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The contrasting dynamics and emotional shifts are vividly portrayed and strongly enhance the intended progression.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Begin this line in a low-pitched, sad voice. Transition into a more neutral, pensive delivery with a normal pitch by the end.
text: Esa casa ya no está, la demolieron hace años. A veces me pregunto si los lugares guardan los ecos de las risas que una vez contuvieron.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio perfectly captures the dynamic instruction, starting with a low-pitched, deeply sad tone and transitioning smoothly into a higher-pitched, more neutral and pensive delivery for the second half.

instruction_evidence.pitch_progression: The speaker clearly starts with a low pitch in the first sentence and raises it to a normal level in the second sentence.
instruction_evidence.emotion_progression: The initial delivery is audibly sad and heavy, which effectively shifts to a contemplative, neutral tone after the pause.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds human-like, and the emotional transition is handled smoothly without noticeable artifacts.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The emotional shift is well-acted and strongly enhances the narrative context of the text.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Start off speaking quietly with a worried tone, but build in volume and intensity, ending in an angry shout.
text: Les expliqué la situación una y otra vez, pero parecía que no me escuchaban. Repetí todos los detalles, les mostré los documentos, y aun así no hicieron nada. ¡Es increíble que después de todo eso, todavía me digan que es mi culpa!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio clearly follows the dynamic progression, starting with a quiet, worried whisper and dramatically transitioning into a loud, angry shout at the end.

instruction_evidence.volume_progression: The audio begins with very low volume (whispering) and finishes with a loud, projected shout.
instruction_evidence.emotion_progression: The initial tone effectively conveys anxiety and worry, which sharply turns into palpable anger in the final sentence.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice is free of synthetic artifacts, and both the whispering and the shouting sound highly realistic and human.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery exhibits excellent dynamic range and emotional depth, perfectly capturing the growing frustration and climax of the text.
